name: COBIT 2019
description: Control Objectives for Information and Related Technologies — framework for governance and management of enterprise IT. Provides a comprehensive guide for IT governance.

controls.title: Ensured Governance Framework Setting and Maintenance
controls.description: Analyze and articulate the requirements for the governance of enterprise IT and put in place and maintain effective enabling structures, principles, processes and practices.

controls.title: Ensured Benefits Delivery
controls.description: Secure optimal value from IT-enabled initiatives, services and assets; cost-efficient delivery of solutions and services; and a reliable, accurate picture of costs and likely benefits.

controls.title: Ensured Risk Optimization
controls.description: Ensure that IT-related enterprise risk does not exceed risk appetite and risk tolerance, the impact of IT risk to enterprise value is identified and managed.

controls.title: Managed I&T Management Framework
controls.description: Clarify and maintain the mission and vision of the management of enterprise I&T in line with guiding principles; implement and maintain the mechanisms and authority required.

controls.title: Managed Strategy
controls.description: Provide a holistic view of the current business and IT environment, the future direction, and the initiatives required to migrate to the desired future environment.

controls.title: Managed Risk
controls.description: Continually identify, assess, and reduce IT-related risk within levels of tolerance set by enterprise executive management.

controls.title: Managed Security
controls.description: Define, operate, and monitor a system for information security management.

controls.title: Managed Programs
controls.description: Manage all programs from the investment portfolio in alignment with enterprise strategy and in a co-ordinated way.

controls.title: Managed Solutions Identification and Build
controls.description: Establish and maintain identified solutions in line with enterprise requirements covering design, development/acquisition, testing, configuration management.

controls.title: Managed IT Changes
controls.description: Manage all changes in a controlled manner, including standard changes and emergency maintenance relating to business processes, applications and infrastructure.

controls.title: Managed Operations
controls.description: Coordinate and execute the activities and operational procedures required to deliver internal and outsourced IT services.

controls.title: Managed Service Requests and Incidents
controls.description: Provide timely and effective response to user requests and resolution of all types of incidents; restore normal service; record and fulfill user requests.

controls.title: Managed Continuity
controls.description: Maintain a complete, current and tested plan for business continuity in the event of a business disruption or major disaster.

controls.title: Managed Security Services
controls.description: Protect enterprise information to maintain the level of information security risk acceptable to the enterprise in accordance with the security policy.

controls.title: Managed Performance and Conformance Monitoring
controls.description: Collect, validate and evaluate business, IT and process goals and metrics; monitor that processes are performing against agreed performance and conformance goals.

controls.title: Managed System of Internal Control
controls.description: Continuously monitor and evaluate the control environment, including self-assessments and independent assurance reviews.

controls.title: Managed Compliance With External Requirements
controls.description: Evaluate that IT and business processes are compliant with laws, regulations and contractual requirements. Obtain assurance that requirements have been identified and complied with.
